summary: The audit checks the 25 units: HUMRTS 101, at least one course from each of the Foundations, Contemporary Issues and Practice lists (more courses from these lists fill the remaining units), and a 3-5 unit capstone by proposal, all letter graded where a letter grade is offered. These courses cannot also count toward your major. Checked by hand: the capstone pathway, the 3.0 GPA in the minor's courses, at least 10 units on Stanford's campus, and petitioned transfer credit. Declare the minor at least two quarters before your degree is conferred.
